## Change

Describe the platform or agent change and its owner.

## Security and governance

- [ ] No real customer, bank, credential, or production data is included.
- [ ] Tool permissions and data classifications remain least privilege.
- [ ] Tests, evaluation, SAST, dependency, secret, IaC, and image gates pass.
- [ ] New consequential actions include human approval.
- [ ] Cloud deployment is not enabled by this change.

## Operational impact

Document SLO, telemetry, cost, rollback, and runbook impact.
